title: Rogan backlash over Malone and McCullough episodes
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Rogan backlash over Malone and McCullough episodes, about 2022 at United States (no place named), and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: But it was because he had Robert Malone and Peter McCulla on.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that around 2022 the well-known podcaster Joe Rogan faced a backlash, and that it was because he had two guests on his show, Robert Malone and Peter McCullough. Michels brings it up while talking about how public figures get punished for airing views outside the mainstream.
